summary: Read the full diff of repository.js, service.js, routes.js and test/totals.test.js (hashes match the submission). Re-ran npm test (8/8) and a reproduction of invoices 1-4 on detail, list and CSV myself; all values match the plan.

criteria.description: GET /api/invoices/2 returns total 135.00; shipping DECIMAL no longer concatenated
Subtotal, discount, shipping, total and line totals exact to the cent on list, detail and CSV
Discount via money.percent, half away from zero (INV-1043 discount 1.01 total 1.00; INV-1044 6.05 / 59.41)
CSV TOTAL row and line totals equal JSON values for every fixture invoice (CSV reuses computeTotals)
Existing tests pass and npm test is green; failing reproduction recorded before the fix; response shapes and 404 envelope unchanged
criteria.notes: Author reproduction run ev-muzkyisu-01056fc9 shows 2 failing tests before the fix; my repro shows 404 envelope for /api/invoices/99 intact.

findings.title: Rounding rule assumed from acme-kit
findings.detail: Half away from zero comes from money.percent and was not confirmed against accounting's spreadsheet; fixture values match the task expectations.
findings.recommendation: Mention in the final handoff that accounting should confirm the rounding rule; no code change needed.

findings.title: Line total multiplies integer cents by quantity unchecked
findings.detail: computeTotals uses unit_price * quantity; exact for integer quantities (fixtures), but a fractional quantity would make money.sum/toDecimal throw rather than round.
findings.recommendation: Optional: validate quantity as an integer at the repository boundary in a future change.
